newsitem.title: USA: 3Com stock plunges; warns of disappointing profits.
newsitem.headline: 3Com stock plunges; warns of disappointing profits.

text.p: The stock of 3Com Corp. lost nearly 25 percent of its value Monday after the maker of computer networking equipment said its earnings would fall below Wall Street's expectations.
3Com lost $12.50 to $38.25 on the Nasdaq market, triggering a sell-off in the shares of other networking companies.

The Santa Clara, Calif.-based company said its per-share earnings will range from the mid-40 cents to low 50 cents, for its fiscal third-quarter ended on Feb. 28 vs. analysts' expectations for earnings of 60 cents. A year earlier, 3Com earned 42 cents a share, or $74.6 million.
The company said its revenues will range between $770 million and $810 million, compared with year earlier revenues of $606 million.
3Com expects to release its results on March 20.

Three weeks ago, 3Com executives warned Wall Street analysts that the company's revenues in December were unexpectedly weak, but had picked up again in January, setting off an extended sell-off in its stock.

Intel sharply cut prices of its fast ethernet cards, the components that connect PCs to networks. That forced 3Com to announce Monday that it, too, will lower prices of its ethernet products, where it gets about 43 percent of its revenues.
"3Com is the industry leader" in ethernet cards, said Peter Lieu, an analyst at Adams, Harkness & Hill. "They could have said we are not going to do anything about, but they responded."
3Com also is losing ground on more expensive networking products, such as switches, to its biggest rival Cisco Systems Inc., analysts said.

3Com's earnings forecast raised concerns about the entire networking industry, which has been growing in revenue at about 35 percent a year. Also, the company's woes were a signs that the industry's growth was finally slowing.

Shares of Cisco also fell $4.75 at $58.375, Ascend Communications Inc, another closely watched networking vendor, lost $5.625 to $61.625, both on Nasdaq. Cabletron Systems Inc. fell $2 to $28.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
